snippet.title: SMS Returns - Elementary Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4670920/SMS_Returns/
Join the official Discord:  https://discord.gg/7fSvvdaqgm

Lost in a bloodstained elementary school, explore the twisted classrooms, hallways, and surrounding courtyard now filled with grim discoveries and eerie messages. The once-familiar childhood setting has become a horrifying realm where whispers linger and sudden pursuit can erupt at any moment.
